title: Daylight saving starts (Los Angeles, 2026-03-08, 02:00 PST -> 03:00 PDT)
derivation: Input tokens 1, 2, 4, ... 64 identify the records. 07:59Z Mar 7 = Mar 6 23:59 PST (1). 08:00Z Mar 7 = Mar 7 00:00 PST (2). 09:30Z Mar 8 = 01:30 PST (4) and 10:30Z = 03:30 PDT (8), so the 23-hour Mar 8 also has 06:59Z Mar 9 = 23:59 PDT (16): Mar 8 = 28. 07:00Z Mar 9 = Mar 9 00:00 PDT (32). 07:00Z Mar 10 = Mar 10 00:00 PDT (64). Today (Mar 10) 64; the week starts Mar 4 and the 30 days Feb 9, so both are 127.
